text:
Zara: heads-up eu3 rack5 host-5-02 p95 jump from 60ms -> 210ms around 11:12UTC, nic_tx_queue_len spiked to ~210. A dedicated tenant `clip-render-ded` is the top talker.
Owen: looking. host-5-02 pci_util=87%, tx_queue_len sustained ~210s, allocator logs show 2 quick handoff attempts failed due to AZ affinity -> retried then gave up. That churn likely amplified egress.
Priya: repeating retries are the problem. We should preflight simulated handoffs before attempting to move dedicated tenants so we don't create thrash. Suggest a preflight that checks: warm-pool capacity in-az, affinity constraints, estimated egress and GPU-hr cost, and returns PASS/FAIL + suggestions.
Sasha: agree. Example stub: `allocator preflight --tenant clip-render-ded --target warm-pool-eu3` -> returns FAIL(reason=warm-pool insufficient, can_create_cushion=true, est_cost=0.6GPUh).
InfraBot: preflight result for clip-render-ded -> FAIL(warm-pool_capacity=0, az_affinity_block=true, suggested_action=create_local_cushion).
Zara: okay fallback: create local cushion in same AZ with preserve-kv and attach soft egress shaper. Command: `allocator move-tenant --tenant=clip-render-ded --to=cushion-rack5 --preserve-kv --billing-tag=cushion_auto`
Owen: Allocator: handoff accepted; warming KV on cushion-rack5. Applying egress_shaper profile `soft-260mbit`. Host tc applied: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 260mbit burst 64k latency 50ms`. p95 dropped 210ms -> 85ms in ~80s.
BillingBot: Notice: billing-tag cushion_auto set. Estimated immediate delta: +0.55 GPU-hrs, est cost +$0.70. Event will be attached to tenant invoice and console notification.
Priya: follow-ups: 1) implement preflight simulation and surface result in console modal with three buttons: "auto-create cushion (cost shown)", "notify tenant owner", "abort"; 2) scheduler policy: if preflight FAIL -> do not retry handoffs automatically; instead suggest cushion; 3) add a short audit log and billing annotation for any infra-created cushion.
Sasha: filing INFRA-99901 to track preflight + console modal + retry-backoff + billing annotation. Assign infra-scheduler + console + billing.
Zara: keeping cushion active for 30m, will revert if stable. Thanks for quick triage, good win for avoiding handoff thrash. :thumbsup:
